items.title: Reservoir Fires Off Infringement and DMCA Suits Against Suno and Anthropic, Demanding Nearly $340 Million
items.excerpt: Reservoir is seeking hundreds of millions of dollars in damages from Anthropic and Suno in a pair of new copyright infringement suits.

items.title: Claude's lyrics are diluting real lyrics, say music publishers in latest Anthropic proceedings
items.excerpt: The big debate over whether or not AI training is fair use under US copyright law was taking place in court again yesterday, this time in the context of music, specifically lyrics, with the copyright legal battle between AI company Anthropic and the Universal, Concord and ABKCO music publishers

items.title: Suno admits it has not deleted all the recordings used to train its AI, in answer to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' lawsuit
items.excerpt: Suno's 44-page answer, filed October 20 in the US District Court for the District of Massachusetts, concedes it has not deleted all recordings used to train its AI models, responding to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' claims. (Date from MBW RSS; article body 403-blocked to fetchers.)

items.title: Universal Music Group & AI Gaming Company TYGER Announce Licensing Deal
items.excerpt: UMG becomes the first major to license TYGER, an AI gaming platform that adapts licensed songs to gameplay in real time.

items.title: Spotify Co-CEOs Talk AI Remixing Tool: 'We're the Right Company to Do This'
items.excerpt: Spotify's co-CEOs discussed the coming AI music remixing tool for the platform's subscribers, saying it will generate new revenue for the industry.

items.title: Spotify's current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
items.excerpt: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

items.title: AI-Generated Music and the Future of Creativity Discussed at Billboard Latin Music Week
items.excerpt: AI in music and protecting human creators was discussed at a Billboard Latin Music Week panel featuring Cristina Perpiñá-Robert and Pierre Hachar Jr.

items.title: Is The Humanity of Instruments Under Threat from AI?
items.excerpt: The surge in vibe-coded instrument plugins has been overwhelming, but do we risk losing the most important feature, humanity?

items.title: Stop sending me vibecoded AI plugins, I'm begging you
items.excerpt: MusicTech’s inbox is drowning in a sea of vibecoded plugins. Here’s why that’s a problem, and which indie developers are doing it properly.

items.title: New studies explore AI expectations, jobs impact and gender gap
items.excerpt: Beyond the AI-music debates that have been gripping our industry, there’s a lot to think about in terms of the other ways AI will affect our jobs and wider society. Several studies published in recent days offer new perspectives on that.

items.title: Publishing body ICMP blasts potential AI rules in Australia
items.excerpt: Australia’s government is currently devising its future policies on AI, training and copyright. We recently reported on labels body ARIA’s boss Annabelle Herd’s testimony at a select-committee hearing as part of that process.

items.title: Is There a Future for 'Humanoid Robot Performances'? South Korea's Galaxy Corporation Thinks So
items.excerpt: South Korea-based Galaxy Corporation is combining entertainment IP, AI, and humanoid robots for an upcoming Halloween-inspired event in CA.

items.title: Fontaines DC Blindsided by Unsanctioned, 'Ironic' Use of AI on 'Marianne' Music Video
items.excerpt: Fontaines D.C. found themselves in a darkly ironic AI scandal after they found out someone used the tech on one of their music videos.

items.title: AI K-pop band under fire after creators 'impregnated' member to write her out of group
items.excerpt: An AI K-Pop group is facing backlash after its creators announced that one of its members was pregnant to write her out of the band.

items.title: Agentic Music Post-Production (MixAgent)
items.excerpt: MixAgent is an agentic pipeline for music post-production that follows audio engineers' workflow: grouping and planning agents build interpretable, editable mixing plans guided by a reference song.

items.title: MuLaCover: Flexible Cover Song Generation via Symbolic Tonal Control
items.excerpt: MuLaCover re-renders existing songs with pretrained music language models by explicitly controlling tonal content (melody and chords) while reshaping style, arrangement and other attributes.

items.title: Soloist: A Generative Model for Blind Voice Separation in the Wild
items.excerpt: Soloist is a generative model that recovers individual voices from overlapping speech, environmental noise and music without isolated source recordings for supervision.
